newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Ssangyong announces restructuring.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Ssangyong announces restructuring.

text.p: South Korea's Ssangyong Group said on Wednesday it would reduce its subsidiaries to 21 from the current 25 in a restructuring drive aimed at improving its competitiveness.
Analysts said the group ran into financial troubles as a result of heavy investment in its automobile unit Ssangyong Motor Co Ltd.
They said Ssangyong accumulated a total of 3.7 trillion won of debt after heavy investments in development of new vehicles. The company put its debts at 3.2 trillion won.
Two weeks ago, Ssangyong Motor, a specialised maker of four wheel-drive utility vehicles, said it would sell its headquarter building and other assets to raise about 400 billion won.
The automaker posted a net loss of 228.5 billion won in 1996, against a 126.2 billion won loss in 1995.
